name: stockscreen-mcp
description: Daily stock screens, RS ratings, market breadth and group rankings for 12 markets. No API keys.
long_description: Minervini, CANSLIM, VCP and 25 more preset screens, relative-strength ratings, market health and StockBee-style breadth, and IBD-style industry group rankings for the US, Canada, Germany, Hong Kong, China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, India, Singapore, Malaysia and Australia. Reads the end-of-day snapshot the open-source stock-screener project publishes after every market close. Educational screening data, not investment advice.
